{"metadata":{"description":"Windows toast notifications and per-situation sounds for the DSH desktop app","id":"gh:1413990122","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-notify-desktop","slug":"paleech0/dsh-notify-desktop","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Windows toast notifications and per-situation sounds for the DSH desktop app"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-notify-desktop"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-notify-desktop) · 中文文档 · English"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Windows toast notifications for the DSH desktop app. A session finishes, fails, or stops to ask you
"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"something — you get a native notification with a sound and a piece of text chosen for that situation"},{"id":"p4s3","text":", and
clicking it brings the DSH window back to the front."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## What's new in 0.2.5"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **Three reminder styles.** After "waiting longer than N minutes" you can now choose **Once**, **Re"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"peat** (nudge every
M minutes until the wait is answered), or **Stay on screen** — a single toast th"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"at remains visible until you dismiss
it, with the sound played once. Once remains the default, so ex"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"isting settings are unchanged.
- **Custom sounds can be renamed**, Chinese names included.
- **Non-w"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"av custom sounds play again** (fixed in 0.2.4).
- **The shipped author sounds follow the interface l"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"anguage**: English shows Task completed, not the Chinese file name.
- **The reminder style select ma"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"tches the delay field** and sits in the same column; an imported sound is laid out on
two lines so a"},{"id":"p6s8","text":" long file name no longer squeezes its buttons into one block."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## What's new in 0.2.4"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **Non-wav custom sounds play again.** 0.2.3 started transcoding into a `.part` file and forgot to "},{"id":"p8s2","text":"name the output
format; ffmpeg cannot infer a container from that suffix, so mp3 / flac and friends "},{"id":"p8s3","text":"went silent and no cache was
written. Fixed, and the host now records a child that exits abnormally "},{"id":"p8s4","text":"in the diagnostics ring
(`GET /dsh-notify/debug`) instead of failing silently.
- **Custom sounds can"},{"id":"p8s5","text":" be renamed** from the "Custom sounds" card, Chinese names included; every situation using the
file "},{"id":"p8s6","text":"follows the new name.
- **Compatibility.** Verified on DSH desktop **0.2.2-rc.1** (plugin loading, p"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"rojection delivery, host
toast, diagnostics and text-template routes). The declared range is unchang"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"ed (`>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`)."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## What you get"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- **Told when it matters** — turn ends (completed, error, aborted, blocked, max-tokens), approval
re"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"quests, questions, plan reviews, and one nudge for a wait that drags on.
- **Quiet when you are ther"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"e** — nothing pops while the DSH window has focus, and each event notifies
once (three-second de-dup"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"lication).
- **A sound and a text per situation** — nine situations (five turn ends, three waits, on"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"e reminder),
each with its own sound and its own popup text; each situation can store up to three cu"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"stom texts, and
every row has a Preview button that shows and plays exactly what it will do.
- **Bil"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"ingual** — the plugin's own interface and popup text switch between Chinese and English, either
pinn"},{"id":"p10s8","text":"ed or following the DSH language.
- **Three delivery modes** — toast + sound, toast only (silent), s"},{"id":"p10s9","text":"ound only (no toast).
- **Your own sounds and words** — sounds come from the Windows library, the au"},{"id":"p10s10","text":"thor sounds shipped in
`sounds/`, or files you import; texts have a name, a title, a body and placeh"},{"id":"p10s11","text":"olders, live in a
local JSON file, and can be edited or deleted (with an inline confirmation).
- **N"},{"id":"p10s12","text":"ever a long ring** — a file sound stops after eight seconds, and stops at once when you mute
notific"},{"id":"p10s13","text":"ations or come back to the window.
- **Click to come back** — the toast raises the DSH window; it de"},{"id":"p10s14","text":"liberately does not jump to the session."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Requirements: Windows and the DSH desktop app (profile `desktop`), runtime 0.2.x. `ffmpeg` on `PATH`"},{"id":"p11s2","text":" is
optional and only used to transcode custom sounds that are not `.wav`."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| Verified on | DSH desktop **0.2.2-rc.1**: plugin loading, projection delivery, host toast, diagnos"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"tics and text-template routes, plus the settings page's Chinese/English switch (evidence); earlier r"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"uns — 0.2.1-rc.5 (toast identity) and rc.3 / rc.2 / 0.2.0-rc.2 — are kept in `docs/acceptance/` |
| "},{"id":"p13s4","text":"Declared range | `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0` (the loader's semver gate) — this lets the loader **accept*"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"* the whole 0.2 line from 0.2.0-rc.2 on, prereleases included; **only the versions verified above ar"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"e tested — anything else inside the range is allowed but not guaranteed**. 0.2.0-rc.1 and older, and"},{"id":"p13s7","text":" 0.3.x, are outside it |
| Platform | Windows desktop profile only; the web profile has no toast cha"},{"id":"p13s8","text":"nnel and is untested |
| Seam check | The 0.2.2 runtime image ships no `.d.ts`; every seam used here"},{"id":"p13s9","text":" was checked against its compiled JS and still matches |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"The compatibility claim lives in both `dsh.engines.dsh` and `peerDependencies.@deepseek-ai/dsh` (kep"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"t
identical). The loader checks it with `semver.satisfies(runtime, range, { includePrerelease: true "},{"id":"p14s3","text":"})`; a
mismatch makes it skip the plugin rather than load it. On another runtime, grant an exemption"},{"id":"p14s4","text":")`; a
mismatch makes it skip the plugin rather than load it. On another runtime, grant an exemption:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Two halves, and no harness code is modified."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"- The **host half** registers one session projection (`notify`) and a few same-origin routes; it als"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"o
owns the text-template file (atomic write, per-situation cap and length validation).
- The **clien"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"t half** reads that projection from the session list, decides whether a notification is
warranted, c"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"omposes the situation's sound and text, and sends it: a host PowerShell toast while the
window is un"},{"id":"p18s5","text":"focused, the renderer's own notification as the fallback."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Questions arrive from two places on purpose, and neither can be dropped. Questions asked as tool cal"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"ls
reach the projection; service-level asks such as the plan review never enter the session log, so "},{"id":"p19s3","text":"the host
observes the `user-questions/request` waterfall with `{ global: true }` and hands them to t"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"he client over
a bounded queue. A cross-source key keeps the two copies from double-toasting."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| Route | Purpose |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| `GET /dsh-notify/debug` | Projection state, recent client reports, ffmpeg and player status |
| `P"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"OST /dsh-notify/toast` | Raise one toast (title, body, sound id) |
| `POST /dsh-notify/focus` | Rais"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"e the window through `dsh://open` |
| `POST /dsh-notify/silence` | Stop the sound that is playing |
"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"| `GET/POST /dsh-notify/sound-library` | List the two library folders |
| `POST /dsh-notify/import-s"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"ound`, `/delete-sound` | Add or remove a custom sound |
| `GET/POST /dsh-notify/sound-cache` | Repor"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"t or clear the transcode cache |
| `GET/POST /dsh-notify/text-templates` | Read every saved text; sa"},{"id":"p21s7","text":"ve or delete one |
| `POST /dsh-notify/pick-file`, `GET /dsh-notify/foreground` | Windows file picke"},{"id":"p21s8","text":"r; OS-level focus answer |
[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
